currentWork.title: FINAL.27 route color/fullscreen PIN fix — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.27 is live. PR #152 merged to main at db781de00bf684e4fab0f4ba0aea7efbb9d67b1c. Vercel production deployment dpl_AxpA47bQjVqAk5K38ipVL8p6aVAy is READY. GitHub Pages run 37492638028 succeeded and the live version endpoint reports 2026.10.07-FINAL.27.
rootCauses: The prior motorway style was orange (#f97316), not red, so it could never satisfy the requested red highway display.

The prior highlight classifier only treated ORS Highway bit 1 as highlighted. FINAL.27 also highlights Tollways bit 2 because Japanese expressway/toll routing data can carry either or both bits; ordinary segments remain blue.

Fullscreen map mode elevated the map to z-index 15000 while machine modals remained at z-index 80, and the prior native element Fullscreen path could place only the map element in the fullscreen top layer. This could make PIN-opened details inaccessible or invisible.
scope: Ordinary route sections are blue (#2563eb). ORS motorway or tollway sections are red (#dc2626).
Legend and footnote explicitly say 高速・有料道路 / 赤.
Fullscreen MAP uses app-managed full-viewport mode as the authoritative path; no map-element native fullscreen request is required.
Open modals are raised above the fullscreen map and machine PIN wrappers are explicitly pointer-interactive.
Real Edge tests require tapping a machine PIN while fullscreen is active and observing the machine detail modal.
Existing HGV vehicle settings, Analytics engine, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain preserved.
